g.text: AA05 - Role-Based Authorization and Audit Logging
[no required role in local route table]
current Actor with roles / authentication error
[none of the actor's roles is allowed]
[at least one actor role is allowed]
show denied feedback without protected data
Audit writes are awaited and retried once for transient persistence failure.
If retry fails, report a sanitized requestId through protected operational
alerting and preserve the original 401/403 response; never fail open.
A user with multiple roles is authorized when any role is allowed
for this operation. This role check does not bypass ownership checks
required by customer-data operations; see the ownership SD.
